messages:
Priya (AE): Hey team — ACME POC stuck on final step. They say users can't be provisioned via SCIM, and SSO logins are failing intermittently. Need a quick triage before tomorrow's exec demo.
Tom S. (SE): Can you paste the SCIM error? 403 could be token / scope or org-v2 vs org-v1 mismatch.
Ben (Customer Eng): Here's the SCIM response from their Okta->our endpoint: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`
Ben (Customer Eng): body: `{\"status\":403,\"message\":\"insufficient_permissions: token missing scope scim:write\"}`
Tom S. (SE): Hmm — they claim they used the UI-generated hosted API key for SCIM provisioning. Hosted API keys should have scim scopes but we recently changed the default to exclude SCIM for trial orgs.
Priya (AE): They were on a trial org yes. Is there a way to enable SCIM for this tenant quickly? Execs are watching.
DevEx Bot: @Tom S. — you can flip tenant flag `enable_scim=true` from the console or call PATCH /admin/tenants/:id. Quick command: ```curl -X PATCH -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" https://control.redwood.ai/admin/tenants/ACME --data '{"enable_scim":true}'```
Tom S. (SE): I'm on it. Also want to mention the SAML issue: IdP Admin reported that their assertion NameID is transient email-format but our SP expects persistent ID. Some users can't complete SSO.
IdP Admin: Confirmed. Okta's default is `NameIDFormat:urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`. Their IdP team can switch to `persistent` but they'd prefer we accept email until they roll changes.
Security (SOC): From compliance side we prefer persistent, but for a POC we can allow email format for login only if we log and flag. Need an opt-in tenant config and audit trail.
Tom S. (SE): I can enable fallback matching on email for this tenant to let logins through while we log mismatches. Will make it time-limited.
Ben (Customer Eng): After I turned on `enable_scim` the SCIM calls now 200 on my side for user create, but group sync still fails with 409 on duplicate externalId. Payload: `{\"schemas\":[...],\"externalId\":\"okta|group|123\"}`
Tom S. (SE): 409 means we map to an existing internal group. Our SCIM dedupe tries to safe-guard; ok to map the Okta group to existing group if name matches?
Priya (AE): ACME expects group names to be used to merge. They already created a group named "engineering" manually in the console. We should accept linking instead of creating duplicate.
Tom S. (SE): I'll adjust dedupe policy to prefer linking on exact name match for this tenant. Will push change now, rolling for this tenant only.
DevEx Bot: Rolling feature: `scim_group_dedupe=link_on_name` for tenant ACME deployed to canary (nodes: rdw-dedicated-03).
IdP Admin: Quick question — do we need to update SAML attribute mappings? We're not sending `employeeNumber` which their app expects for role mapping.
Ben (Customer Eng): ACME's RBAC is driven by `employeeNumber` -> role. If not present, default role is viewer and they can't access model endpoints.
Tom S. (SE): We can add a temporary SCIM transform to copy `urn:okta:attribute:employeeNumber` into `employeeNumber` during provisioning as a stop-gap. Will submit transform change to canary.
Security (SOC): Make sure transforms are audited. Also confirm the hosted API key scope for SCIM write was turned on only for this tenant and not broadly.
Priya (AE): Timeline? Demo is tomorrow 10am PST.
Tom S. (SE): Plan: 1) enable_scim=true now (done), 2) enable email fallback on SAML for logins (in 15m), 3) change group dedupe policy (in 30m), 4) add SCIM attribute transform for employeeNumber (post-demo rollback planned). I'll post verification.
Ben (Customer Eng): Verified: user create OK, group now links, some logins succeed. Still seeing 1 user failing SSO with `NameID invalid format`.
IdP Admin: That user's IdP assertion was broken (old mapping). We fixed it and retried — success.
Priya (AE): Amazing — can you add temporary API key for ACME support engineers to debug tomorrow?
Tom S. (SE): I'll generate a support-scim key for tenant ACME with `scim:read scim:write` scopes and TTL 24h. Posting key in 1:1 with Ben.
DevEx Bot: Support key created and emailed to Ben. Key ID: sk-support-ACME-20240310
Security (SOC): Approved temporary measures for POC only. Please document and schedule automatic rollback in 48h.
Priya (AE): Thanks all — I'll update ACME and schedule a short prep call before the demo. :thumbsup:
